60121541.s: Al Tawiyah Tower, also known as Al Tawiyah Fort, is a fortified tower in the middle of Jubail Governorate in Saudi Arabia. It is the only symbolic archaeological and heritage landmark in Jubail and one of the witnesses to the early period of Jubail's founding, as it is linked to the era of King Abdulaziz Al Saud. The fort was built in 1928 and is believed to have been built to protect the Al Tawiyah well.
